note: Hand-written inputs to scripts/build-control-baseline.py. Most determinations are derived: a control an image criterion anchors to is image-owned, and one only a platform expectation anchors to takes that expectation's origination. This file holds what derivation cannot decide: a default for each family whose controls no image can meet, and an override, with its reason, wherever the derived answer would be wrong. The generator refuses an override that repeats what derivation already gives.
undetermined: Not yet determined for images in general. Whether the image implements this depends on its function; a database authenticates users and a static file server does not. Each image determines it in its own component definition.

at.reason: Awareness and training concern people, not a software component.

ca.reason: Assessment, authorization, and monitoring are performed on the system by the organization; an image is assessed, it does not assess.

cp.reason: Contingency planning, backup, and recovery are planned and exercised by the organization operating the system. An image holds no state of its own; its data lives on volumes the deployment provides.

ir.reason: Incident response is an organizational capability.

ma.reason: Maintenance of the system is performed by the organization. An image is not maintained in place; it is replaced.

mp.reason: Media protection concerns physical and removable media the organization handles.

pe.reason: Physical and environmental protection belongs to the facility.

pl.reason: Security and privacy planning is performed by the organization for the system.

pm.reason: Program management is organization-wide by definition.

pt.reason: Processing of personally identifiable information is determined by the system's purpose, which the organization decides.

ra.reason: Risk assessment is performed by the organization for the system.

sa.reason: System and services acquisition concerns how the organization acquires and manages systems.

sr.reason: Supply chain risk management plans and processes are organizational. The image's own supply chain properties are recorded against CM-14, CM-2, CM-8, and SI-7(15).

determinations.reason: Policy and procedures are written and maintained by the organization for the system. The standard is an input to them, not a substitute.
